title: Tracing Psychometric Inference in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.12937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Do large language models represent psychological constructs internally, or do they only generate outputs that resemble psychometric structure? We address this question using a cross-persona paradigm across 14 model variants from two families (Llama 3 and Qwen 2.5, 0.5B-14B, base and instruct). Given responses on one psychological scale from real individuals (N = 272 Taiwanese university students), models predict responses on six other scales. At the behavioral level, larger variants reproduce and amplify human cross-scale correlations; amplification persists after correcting the seven-scale human correlations for measurement attenuation. We then examine whether this structure is reflected internally. Contrastive direction analysis finds geometry aligned with the human matrix in larger instruct variants, but little alignment in base variants under this assay. translated_title: 追踪大语言模型中的心理测量推断
translated_abstract: 大语言模型是在内部真正表征了心理构念，还是仅仅生成表面上的心理测量结构？我们通过跨角色范式回答这一问题，研究对象为来自两个家族（Llama 3 和 Qwen 2.5，参数量 0.5B-14B，包含基础版和指令版）的 14 个模型变体。给定真实个体（N = 272 名台湾大学生）在一个心理量表上的回答，模型需要预测其余六个量表上的回答。在行为层面，更大的模型变体能够重现并放大人类的跨量表相关性；即使在校正了七个人类量表的测量衰减之后，这种放大效应依然存在。随后我们检验这种结构是否在模型内部得到反映。对比方向分析发现，在较大的指令版变体中，模型内部的几何结构与人类的心理测量矩阵相一致，而基础版变体在该测试下几乎没有表现出这种对齐。跨模型来看，几何结构强度与行为放大程度相关。
tldr: 该研究通过跨角色预测范式发现，大语言模型（尤其是较大规模的指令微调模型）在行为上重现并放大了人类心理量表的跨量表相关性，且其内部几何结构与人类心理测量结构对齐，表明模型在一定程度上确实内部表征了心理构念。
en_tdlr: Using a cross-persona paradigm, this study shows that larger instruction-tuned LLMs behaviorally reproduce and amplify human cross-scale psychometric correlations, and their internal geometry aligns with the human psychometric structure, indicating genuine internal representation of psychological constructs.
